title: 2 Army soldiers arrested over North Cotabato shooting
summary: KORONADAL CITY — Two Philippine Army soldiers were arrested after allegedly shooting a 23-year-old man traveling from Davao City to Cotabato City in Pigcawayan, North Cotabato, before dawn Thursday,…

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Two Philippine Army soldiers were arrested after allegedly shooting a 23-year-old man traveling from Davao City to Cotabato City in Pigcawayan, North Cotabato, before dawn Thursday, police said. The suspects, both members of the Army’s 7th Infantry Battalion and residents of Midsayap, North Cotabato, were arrested following a pursuit operation shortly after the incident at around 12:30 a.m. on Thursday. According to a police report, the victim, identified only as alias Dats, 23, of Cotabato City, flagged down a police team conducting a mobile checkpoint in Barangay South Manuangan after he was shot.
